cardInfo.name: Boxel UI Guidelines
cardInfo.summary: Ensures boxel-ui components are used in templates and theming guidelines are followed

relatedSkills.contentSummary: The single inventory of every CSS variable a Boxel theme provides: colors, typography roles, spacing, radius, shadows, and how the contract behaves at card boundaries

How templates consume theme tokens: no fallbacks, no literals, surfaces paired once with their foreground, hues written through their ink token, tints via color-mix, and what a component that opts out of the theme does instead
relatedSkills.alternateTitle: Use Boxel Design Tokens for Theming

relatedSkills.contentSummary: Templates never @import a font; the Theme card derives Google Fonts links from its font stacks and other stylesheets go in customCssImports
relatedSkills.alternateTitle: Font Loading: Theme Card Owns Imports

relatedSkills.contentSummary: Render fields with <@fields.x />; read @model.x only for conditionals, HTML attributes, fallback values and JS getters

Isolated, embedded and fitted template shapes, the FittedCard component and its blocks, icons with intrinsic sizes, semantic markup, multi-stack DOM scoping, and entrance animations that never rest invisible
Multi-page host-mode printing, ancestor unclipping, SVG semantic marks, cross-browser fill rules, and PDF verification
Cards live inside containers of unknown size, so layout responds to @container queries on the host-provided containers, never to vw/vh or @media viewport queries
relatedSkills.alternateTitle: Use Container Queries, Not Viewport Units

relatedSkills.contentSummary: Text and media stay inside their box: ellipsize, clamp, wrap and constrain instead of letting content escape the card
Drive boxel-ui components through their args and CSS custom properties, and when none fits write a small typed component that could be contributed back
relatedSkills.alternateTitle: Prefer Component APIs; Write New Components When Needed

relatedSkills.contentSummary: The boxel-ui component reference, picking the variant instead of neutralizing a component, and the drag-and-drop quality bar
Keep <style scoped> blocks at or under 40% of the file and deduplicate CSS across formats

How the host wraps a child card render in CardContainer chrome and how the parent shapes it: the theme cascade, a class on the field, @displayContainer, the plural-field wrapper trap, and what the child must never decorate
The final tick list before a card template is done: components, tokens, pairings, selectors, semantics, and hooks
